split_note: The intended_splits block below records one 75/21/12 split produced by an early run of dataset_processor.py. It does NOT describe the shipped processed_data/ and optimized_data/ directories: the splitter was originally re-run without a fixed seed and without clearing previous outputs, so the on-disk splits are contaminated (all val and test images also appear in train; 108/82/57 files). The deployed detector was in effect trained on all 108 images and no held-out evaluation is reported. See the Data-split note in README.md.
